description: A DATA-ACK whose data CRC fails still acknowledges: its RX LWE, in the checked header, confirms our C_PDU, while its segment is discarded and not acknowledged.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050). The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). At 108000 the C_PDU (DATA C_PDU, 10 bytes: the S_PDU with TTD and 'ping') is placed whole in one DATA-ONLY (type 9, C-0172, C-0505): FSN 0, the first from the initial TX UWE 65535 (C-0189, C-0191, C-0766), C_PDU START and END (C-0506), DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked (delivery mode ORDER 0, A-0077), TX WIN UWE and TX WIN LWE both set since FSN 0 is now both edges (C-0185, C-0186, C-1122). 29 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20. When the transmission ends at 118350, dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms (C-1120). At 126000 the peer, which has data of its own for us, sends a DATA-ACK (type 11): FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, both TX WIN flags, a 10-byte segment, and RX LWE 1 with no Selective Acks; but its data CRC arrives corrupted (its last byte inverted). The header and its CRC are good, and a valid header is processed whatever the data CRC (C-0136, C-0141); the acknowledgement of a DATA-ACK is all in the header (C.4.6.3), so its acknowledgement part is used as an ACK-ONLY's would be (C-1133): FSN 0 is acknowledged and TX LWE moves to 1 (C-0780, C-0781), dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679, C-0680, C-1130) and dts.ttd is cancelled. The segment is discarded (C-0836, C-0839) and not acknowledged (C-0216): nothing is stored, RX LWE stays 0, and no acknowledgement is owed, so the burst ends at 127000 with nothing queued and the peer will retransmit its FSN 0. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): the 29-byte DATA-ONLY transmission leaves 21 bytes of its second block; no acknowledgement goes in it and its only addressee, 0.0.1.3, is recorded Ed4 (C-0050), so one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes, EOT 10) follows the DATA-ONLY (C-0367, C-0887) and 10 bytes are zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
